description: This file defines a utility class CalendarEnumerations that provides methods to convert various calendar-related enumeration types into EnumOptionData objects, and to obtain lists of such options. It uses domain-specific classes like CalendarType, CalendarRemindBy, CalendarFrequencyType, etc., and provides methods to generate options for these enumerations, often filtered by validity. The class acts as a helper for representing calendar-related enums in a selectable or displayable form within the application.

classes.name: CalendarEnumerations
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for converting calendar-related enumeration types to EnumOptionData objects and lists, used for representing options in user interfaces or APIs.

methods.name: calendarEntityType(int)
methods.description: Returns an EnumOptionData for a CalendarEntityType based on an integer ID.

methods.name: calendarEntityType(CalendarEntityType)
methods.description: Returns an EnumOptionData representing the given CalendarEntityType.

methods.name: calendarEntityType(CalendarEntityType[]entityTypes)
methods.description: Returns a list of EnumOptionData objects for multiple CalendarEntityType values.

methods.name: calendarType(int)
methods.description: Returns an EnumOptionData for a CalendarType based on an integer ID.

methods.name: calendarType(CalendarType)
methods.description: Returns an EnumOptionData for the specified CalendarType.

methods.name: calendarType(CalendarType[]types)
methods.description: Creates a list of EnumOptionData for multiple CalendarType values.

methods.name: calendarRemindBy(int)
methods.description: Returns an EnumOptionData for CalendarRemindBy based on an integer ID.

methods.name: calendarRemindBy(CalendarRemindBy)
methods.description: Returns an EnumOptionData for the specified CalendarRemindBy.

methods.name: calendarRemindBy(CalendarRemindBy[]remindBys)
methods.description: Creates a list of EnumOptionData for multiple CalendarRemindBy values.

methods.name: calendarFrequencyType(int)
methods.description: Returns an EnumOptionData for CalendarFrequencyType from an integer ID, if valid.

methods.name: calendarFrequencyType(CalendarFrequencyType)
methods.description: Returns an EnumOptionData for a given CalendarFrequencyType, if it is not marked invalid.

methods.name: calendarFrequencyType(CalendarFrequencyType[]calendarFrequencyTypes)
methods.description: Creates a list of EnumOptionData for multiple CalendarFrequencyType values, excluding invalid ones.

methods.name: calendarWeekDaysType(int)
methods.description: Returns an EnumOptionData for CalendarWeekDaysType from an integer ID.

methods.name: calendarWeekDaysType(CalendarWeekDaysType)
methods.description: Returns an EnumOptionData for the given CalendarWeekDaysType, if it is valid.

methods.name: calendarWeekDaysType(CalendarWeekDaysType[]),
methods.description: Creates a list of EnumOptionData for multiple CalendarWeekDaysType values, excluding invalid ones.

methods.name: calendarFrequencyNthDayType(int)
methods.description: Returns an EnumOptionData for NthDayType from an integer ID.

methods.name: calendarFrequencyNthDayType(NthDayType)
methods.description: Returns an EnumOptionData for the given NthDayType.

methods.name: calendarFrequencyNthDayType()
methods.description: Returns a list of EnumOptionData objects representing the various NthDayType options.
